finalCta.paragraph: History: The latest Plug-in Hybrid combines a turbo petrol engine with a more powerful electric motor for extended electric-only driving and lower emissions. Produced from 2020, it offers 225hp combined (180hp from the 1.6L PureTech engine and 81kW electric motor) through an 8-speed e-EAT8 automatic gearbox.
